settings.name: Independent makers, known by name
settings.story: Formelune gives authorship back to the person who shaped the object. Explore process, place, and material before bringing a piece home.

settings.question: How do I know an object will fit my room?
settings.answer: Every product page includes exact dimensions and an in-room scale image when available. Our team can help review placement before you order.

settings.question: Where are pieces made?
settings.answer: Maker, origin, material, and process appear on each product page. We publish only details we can verify.

settings.question: What happens if an item arrives damaged?
settings.answer: Contact us with photos of the packaging and item. We will explain the replacement or refund path without sending you between sellers.

settings.question: Can I return an item?
settings.answer: Eligible items can be returned within the stated window. Product-specific exclusions and fees appear before purchase.
